5. Conclusion
For conducting training models exceeding 100B on lowcommunication decentralized clusters, this paper proposes
DiLoCoX, a low-communication large-scale decentralized
cluster training framework which significantly improves the
speed of model pre-training, expands the scale of model
parameters, and provides theoretical analysis of the convergence. Empirically, we show that DiLoCoX can pre-train
a 107B foundation model over a 1Gbps network. Compared with a centralized cluster, DiLoCoX can significantly
achieve 357x distributed training speed with negligible
